lines.text: Five bright stars twinkling in the sky,
One went to sleep and waved goodbye.
Now there are four, shining high!
Four bright stars twinkling in the sky,
One went to sleep and waved goodbye.
Now there are three, shining high!
Three bright stars twinkling in the sky,
One went to sleep and waved goodbye.
Now there are two, shining high!
Two bright stars twinkling in the sky,
One went to sleep and waved goodbye.
Now there are one, shining high!
One bright star twinkling in the sky,
One went to sleep and waved goodbye.
Now the sky is sleepy. Night, night, sky!
